notes: «حدثني أعلمهم، بذاك يعني ابن عباس»: the transmitter is described as «أعلمهم»; the reporter's gloss «يعني ابن عباس» names him, so the link is «ابن عباس» (rule 8: not unnamed). The description itself is not a link.
Ibn Abbas's words are the saying, so he is the last link; the Prophet is the end.
